title: In-app in-page push bid via bid.ext body/image_url/href aliases on a widget/zone-only imp

source.name: ortbtools In-Page Push dialect contract — in-app context
source.notes: Exercises the same widget/zone in-page-push carrier inside an App request object instead of a Site object, and covers the remaining body/image_url/href aliases not used by the web-context sibling cases.

modifications: Wholly original OpenRTB envelope, imp, app, device and bid fields.
IP uses TEST-NET-1 192.0.2.44; user/app identifiers are clearly synthetic fixture strings; asset/click/tracking URLs use reserved .test hostnames.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor, publisher or advertiser data. IP 192.0.2.44 is TEST-NET-1; user.id/app.bundle are synthetic-fixture strings; every asset/click/tracking URL uses a reserved .test hostname.

device.ua: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 14) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36

ext.title: A rooftop garden after rain
ext.body: Read what three reviewers said about the new app tab.

specNotes: packages/core/dialects/inpage-push.js pickAlias() covers description via description|body|desc, image via image|image_url|picture and click via url|click|click_url|href|link; this case uses body/image_url/href to cover the remaining untested aliases from those lists (canonical title and icon are reused here).

packages/core/format-detect.js: context detection (app→INAPP) is independent of the format axis; the same missing FORMATS.INPAGE tag for OpenRTB-shaped in-page-push bids applies under App exactly as under Site.

OpenRTB object-model requirements require at least one Banner, Video, Audio or Native object. A widget/zone extension alone does not satisfy that baseline requirement; imp.format_required is an expected error under both the IAB baseline and the current response-focused inpage-push dialect. The vendor format-tag/preview gap is separate from this correct diagnostic.
notes: Uses a minimal App object (id/name/bundle) per the pattern already established in the audio in-app corpus, with device.ua/ip supplied so this case does not additionally exercise the unrelated optional-Device-attributes gap (DEF-100, resolved by 021 on 2026-09-08: those findings are warnings now).

preview.limitation: No renderable creative field (adm/native/iurl) is present in the response; the winning bid's content lives entirely in bid.ext, which the preview pipeline never reads.
preview.capabilityGap: The in-page push dialect resolves the body/image_url/href aliases for validation, but the Inspector's creative preview has no renderer for any bid.ext card, in-app or web.

knownGap.note: 028: Core and HTTP expectations pass. Retained signatures describe unresolved preview behavior owned by Opus; no preview expectation was changed.
